data.title: 椎名真白 · 画室里的赭色指印
data.description: 画室窗边，真白穿燕麦色亚麻工作罩衫，坐在画架前用布擦掉手指上的赭色颜料。她发现纸角留下一个小指印，专注地歪头端详，随后换起画笔把它接成一片叶子。
data.action: 擦去指上颜料，把纸角的意外指印补成一片叶子。
data.promptProse: Mashiro Shiina sits at the window-side easel, wiping ochre paint from her fingers with a cloth. Her oatmeal linen smock covers an opaque charcoal dress, cuffs rolled neatly. Seeing a small fingerprint on the paper corner, she tilts her head and extends it into a leaf with her brush. Clear soft window light illuminates paper grain and stained fingertips, while the medium view leaves easel braces and studio supplies in quieter shade behind.
